summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Kings Pride — Golden Palm City. 16/16 backend pytest tests passed (incl. 5 new tests for extended Project schema: description/gallery/amenities/masterplan_url/area/plot_sizes/connectivity on flagship + all 4 slugs). 11/11 frontend Playwright flows passed: IntroLoader appears on first visit with counter reaching ~100 then unmounts, sessionStorage gpc_intro_seen_v1 is set, intro skipped on reload, particles-3d canvas renders full-bleed in hero, AmbientAudio toggle flips 'Silent' <-> 'Ambience', clicking project image navigates to /projects/golden-palm-city, project detail renders title + gallery-main + 6 highlights + 8 amenity cards + WhatsApp concierge CTA + 3 other-project links, gallery thumb click swaps main image src, back-button returns to /, Explore CTA navigates to detail, invalid slug shows 'Project not found' with back-home-link. Zero page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx logs an AxiosError to console when the slug is invalid (visible as 2 console errors during /projects/nonexistent navigation). UX is correct (shows 'Project not found'), but consider catching the 404 silently to keep console clean in production.
Carry-over from iter1 — GET /api/concierge/inquiries is unauthenticated and exposes PII (name/phone/email) for all leads; protect with admin auth before launch.
Carry-over — CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; restrict origins for production.
ProjectDetail relies on direct fetch by slug; the home page already lists all projects — consider sharing a small cache/context to avoid the extra round-trip on every detail navigation.
IntroLoader uses sessionStorage 'gpc_intro_seen_v1' — works as designed, but means returning users across new tabs still see the intro. Confirm intended (current spec says 'once per session').
AmbientAudio creates AudioContext on click — works (label toggles correctly). For browsers that block autoplay until gesture, current gesture-chain implementation is correct.
test_credentials: Not required — app is fully public, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing TEST_ inquiries created in iter1; this iter created 2 more TEST_Concierge inquiries via pytest re-run. Collection: concierge_inquiries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py — 16 tests, runs in ~1.6s against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend hosted at https://golden-sanctuary.preview.emergentagent.com (per frontend/.env). IMPORTANT for UI testing: IntroLoader gates the page for ~3-4s on first visit; either wait for [data-testid=intro-loader] detached state OR set `sessionStorage.gpc_intro_seen_v1='1'` before navigating to skip it. Project detail expects gallery-thumb-{i} indices starting at 0 (thumb-0 is current main, click thumb-1 to verify swap). Invalid-slug navigation produces expected 404/AxiosError console messages — not a bug. AmbientAudio toggle requires user gesture; click works in Playwright.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 4 iteration-2 enhancements (intro loader, ambient audio, particles canvas, project detail pages) function end-to-end with proper integration to the extended backend Project schema.
